newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks remain higher on Wall Street rise.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks remain higher on Wall Street rise.

text.p: Taiwan share prices were higher at mid-session on Tuesday following Wall Street's sharp rise overnight, but brokers said profit-taking at the index's current high levels likely would prevent further gains.
With 90 minutes left, the weighted index was up 44.85 points or 0.52 percent at 8,684.22.
Turnover was an active T$86.70 billion.
"Although the overall index is up, the market lacks clear direction, with most of the sectors encountering profit-taking pressure," said Oliver Fang, analyst for National Securities.
The index, buoyed by expectations of a continuing economic recovery, has gained well over 20 percent in 1997 alone.
Electronics were the main beneficiary of the Wall Street rise, gaining 3.55 percent.
